items.title: How much does each new, undocumented reason raise legal exposure?
items.description: Drag how many reasons beyond the documented PIP record get introduced in the meeting — the kind of thing that slips out when a manager over-explains under pressure. L3's actual script keeps this at zero throughout, even under pushback. Each additional undocumented reason is a new statement that doesn't match the written record, which is exactly the mismatch L2 identifies as real legal exposure.

params.name: newReasonsIntroduced
params.label: New reasons introduced beyond the PIP record

items.compute: const legalExposureRisk = Math.min(100, params.newReasonsIntroduced * 20); return { legalExposureRisk };
